stage_a.source_reconstruction: Reuse logged source selection indices and ARD variances; reconstruct deterministic archived source observations without rerunning source CV.
stage_a.data_transfer: Compact compressed JSON containing required query paths and prior parameters only.
stage_a.analysis: Score calibration and expected verified reward after recommendation for all five regimes; do not use truth or previous verification outcomes as model inputs.
stage_a.interpretation: Development evidence on unchanged old query paths, not a prospective closed-loop result.

change_scope: Target g observation variance for both g mixture-weight and component updates only; calculate before observing any current-batch responses.

base_protocol.backend: Joint 27-node Gaussian-fantasy verification-utility KG, sampling actions evaluated in blocks of 32; same complete 384 recommendation bank.
base_protocol.verification_utility: Failed verification earns zero; successful deployment earns clip((5-f)/10,0,1). The declared simulator bounds the true objective within [-5,5]. This operational utility is distinct from the mathematical chance-constrained objective.
base_protocol.verification_power: Same t/chi-square verifier and 9x12 quadrature. Normalized Golub-Welsch Gamma quadrature avoids overflow at large verification samples.
base_protocol.risk_ard: Source-only marginal covariance likelihood across independent signed task coefficients, known log-variance label noise and projected task intercepts; nonnegative function variances and 1 percent weak total tail. Mean heads retain conditional source selection.
base_protocol.transfer_mixture: Per-head equal prior weights on the source structural model and the fixed-source full dictionary; update weights with pre-observation predictive densities using only paid target observations; retain between-model covariance. Weights stay fixed in Gaussian acquisition fantasies.
base_protocol.analysis_units: Sixteen new paired seed blocks 48-63. Report all ten strata, paired seed bootstrap intervals (nominal and unadjusted), every allocation and all regressions. Do not pool old cohorts.
base_protocol.scoring: Retain feasibility, mathematical feasible regret and old penalized regret; also report realized verified reward, analytically expected verified reward, verifier power and posterior calibration. Simulator truth enters only observation generation and post-decision scoring.
base_protocol.interpretation: Test whether source structure allows a predeclared shorter search and more independent validation to improve deployment at the same target-call cost. Candidate coverage, objective and verifier confidence are unchanged. Finite bank, public eight-dimensional dictionary; no continuous or learned trajectory representation guarantee.
base_protocol.scope: Public canonical inputs and finite dictionary source priors. Not a learned state/trajectory encoder, a factor-level HVD recovery claim or a high-dimensional guarantee.
primary_comparisons: Within each of the ten regime/difficulty strata: learned n24_v928 minus fixed_source n80_v256; predeclared operational allocation comparison.
Within the same stratum and each common allocation: risk_ard_mixture minus fixed_source, and risk_ard_mixture minus target_only.
base_protocol.allocation_rule: All three methods receive all four frozen allocations. Each search and recommendation uses its own planned verification budget from the start. No truth-selected winning allocation is an implementable policy.
base_protocol.source_cost: Source-informed arms use the same archive: 8 tasks x 64 points x 12 replicates = 6144 source calls. Target-only receives no source labels and costs zero source calls. Source cost is separate from the common 1216 target calls; no amortization or source acquisition savings are asserted.
base_protocol.sharding: One independent paid search per seed, regime, difficulty, prior and allocation: 1920 shards, 1 CPU each on node001-node006.
base_protocol.implementation: The target-only arm may use generator supports only to construct simulator truth; fitting, KG and recommendation receive no target support or labels other than paid observations. Source priors fit identical conditional CV and risk ARD as V5, omitting unused adaptive/leave-one-out arms.
